say:0:1220802001:0.text: Is there anyone there? I need help!
say:0:1220802001:0.source_cn: 唉哟……这里有没有人啊？我需要帮忙！

say:1:1220802002:0.text: It sounds like someone nearby is in trouble! Should we go and check it out?
say:1:1220802002:0.source_cn: 附近好像有人在求救！我们要不要过去看看？
say:1:1220802002:0.male: It sounds like someone nearby is in trouble! Should we go and check it out?
say:1:1220802002:0.female: It sounds like someone nearby is in trouble! Should we go and check it out?

say:3:1220804001:1.text: I can't believe my eyes; there are actually people in the lumberyard who aren't with the Whispers!
say:3:1220804001:1.source_cn: 我简直不敢相信我的眼睛，伐木场里居然有不是血薇帮的人！
say:3:1220804001:1.male: I can't believe my eyes; there are actually people in the lumberyard who aren't with the Whispers!
say:3:1220804001:1.female: I can't believe my eyes; there are actually people in the lumberyard who aren't with the Whispers!

say:4:1220804002:1.text: Wait! Look at your clothes... you're a Water Wight!
say:4:1220804002:1.source_cn: 等等！看你的衣服……你是水鬼帮的人！

say:5:1220804003:1.text: Yes... I did join the Wights, but I mean no harm! I just really need some help!
say:5:1220804003:1.source_cn: 我……我确实加入了水鬼帮，但我没有恶意！而且我真的有急...
say:5:1220804003:1.male: Yes... I did join the Wights, but I mean no harm! I just really need some help!
say:5:1220804003:1.female: Yes... I did join the Wights, but I mean no harm! I just really need some help!

choice_prompt:6:1220804003.text: Yes... I did join the Wights, but I mean no harm! I just really need some help!
choice_prompt:6:1220804003.source_cn: 我……我确实加入了水鬼帮，但我没有恶意！而且我真的有急事需要帮忙！
choice_prompt:6:1220804003.male: Yes... I did join the Wights, but I mean no harm! I just really need some help!
choice_prompt:6:1220804003.female: Yes... I did join the Wights, but I mean no harm! I just really need some help!

say:7:1220804005:1.text: My daughter is gravely ill and her doctors say she needs foxtail grass, but it's only found on faraway islands.
say:7:1220804005:1.source_cn: 我女儿病得很重，医生开的药又需要用到狸尾草，但这种果子...

say:8:1220804006:1.text: Rustport had been shut down for a long time, and I couldn't buy it anywhere in the city. With no other options, I had to join the Water Wights and accompany them out to sea to search for it.
say:8:1220804006:1.source_cn: 那时候锈锚港已经封闭很久了，我跑遍了全城也没买到。无奈...

say:9:1220804007:1.text: I understand... But why are you here? Didn't you find some foxtail grass?
say:9:1220804007:1.source_cn: 原来如此……可你为什么会在这里呢？没有找到狸尾草吗？

say:10:1220804008:1.text: I gathered quite a lot of it, but on my return trip, my boat was spotted by the Carmine Whispers. They refused to hear me out and just captured me as a laborer!
say:10:1220804008:1.source_cn: 不，我在岛上摘了不少狸尾草。但是返航的时候，我坐的船被...

say:11:1220804009:1.text: I tried to escape, but the lumberyard is locked up tighter than a drum, not even a fly could escape. I was beaten several times for trying, and now it's hard enough just to walk...
say:11:1220804009:1.source_cn: 我也试着逃跑过，但伐木场被看守得很严，连只鸟都飞不出去...

say:12:1220804010:1.text: I'm at my wit's end... Can you please help me? I just need you to bring the foxtail grass back home for me.
say:12:1220804010:1.source_cn: 我实在没办法了……你们能帮帮我吗？只要帮我把狸尾草带回...
say:12:1220804010:1.male: I'm at my wit's end... Can you please help me? I just need you to bring the foxtail grass back home for me.
say:12:1220804010:1.female: I'm at my wit's end... Can you please help me? I just need you to bring the foxtail grass back home for me.

say:13:1220804011:1.text: Hmm... Chippy can't sense any dishonesty. Magister, should we help him?
say:13:1220804011:1.source_cn: 唔，满满觉得他说的不像是假话。主人，我们要帮忙吗？
say:13:1220804011:1.male: Hmm... Chippy can't sense any dishonesty. Magister, should we help him?
say:13:1220804011:1.female: Hmm... Chippy can't sense any dishonesty. Magister, should we help him?

choice_prompt:14:1220804011.text: Hmm... Chippy can't sense any dishonesty. Magister, should we help him?
choice_prompt:14:1220804011.source_cn: 唔，满满觉得他说的不像是假话。主人，我们要帮忙吗？
choice_prompt:14:1220804011.male: Hmm... Chippy can't sense any dishonesty. Magister, should we help him?
choice_prompt:14:1220804011.female: Hmm... Chippy can't sense any dishonesty. Magister, should we help him?

say:15:1220804012:1.text: Thank you! Thank you so much!
say:15:1220804012:1.male: Thank you! Thank you so much!
say:15:1220804012:1.female: Thank you! Thank you so much!

say:16:1220804017:0.text: There's a small village outside of Rustport's <style="highlight">southern gate</style>. The house at the <style="highlight">far west end</style> is mine. Please, you must save my daughter!
say:16:1220804017:0.male: There's a small village outside of Rustport's <style="highlight">southern gate</style>. The house at the <style="highlight">far west end</style> is mine. Please, you must save my daughter!
say:16:1220804017:0.female: There's a small village outside of Rustport's <style="highlight">southern gate</style>. The house at the <style="highlight">far west end</style> is mine. Please, you must save my daughter!

choice:14:0:1.text: We'll do it for his little girl.
choice:14:0:1.source_cn: 好吧，就当是帮助那可怜的小女孩
choice:14:0:1.male: We'll do it for his little girl.
choice:14:0:1.female: We'll do it for his little girl.

say:18:1220804013:1.text: The Whispers took almost all of my valuables, but I have some money tucked away at home! If you deliver the foxtail grass, my wife will surely reward you.
say:18:1220804013:1.source_cn: 我、我身上值钱的东西都被血薇帮收走了……不过我家里还有...
say:18:1220804013:1.male: The Whispers took almost all of my valuables, but I have some money tucked away at home! If you deliver the foxtail grass, my wife will surely reward you.
say:18:1220804013:1.female: The Whispers took almost all of my valuables, but I have some money tucked away at home! If you deliver the foxtail grass, my wife will surely reward you.

say:19:1220804014:1.text: No! What I'm asking for has nothing to do with the Wights. You're not aiding the gang, you're assisting a father who is at his wits' end...
say:19:1220804014:1.source_cn: 不！我想求你帮忙的这些事和水鬼帮没有任何关系，你不是在...
say:19:1220804014:1.male: No! What I'm asking for has nothing to do with the Wights. You're not aiding the gang, you're assisting a father who is at his wits' end...
say:19:1220804014:1.female: No! What I'm asking for has nothing to do with the Wights. You're not aiding the gang, you're assisting a father who is at his wits' end...

say:20:1220804015:1.text: I beg you, please help my little girl...
say:20:1220804015:1.source_cn: 真的求求你，帮帮我可怜的女儿吧……
say:20:1220804015:1.male: I beg you, please help my little girl...
say:20:1220804015:1.female: I beg you, please help my little girl...

choice_prompt:21:1220804015.text: I beg you, please help my little girl...
choice_prompt:21:1220804015.source_cn: 真的求求你，帮帮我可怜的女儿吧……
choice_prompt:21:1220804015.male: I beg you, please help my little girl...
choice_prompt:21:1220804015.female: I beg you, please help my little girl...

say:22:1220804016:1.text: You'll actually help?! This is amazing, thank you so much!
say:22:1220804016:1.source_cn: 你……你真的答应帮忙了？！太好了，谢谢你！
say:22:1220804016:1.male: You'll actually help?! This is amazing, thank you so much!
say:22:1220804016:1.female: You'll actually help?! This is amazing, thank you so much!

choice:14:2:3.text: Why should I help a Water Wight?
choice:14:2:3.source_cn: 我凭什么帮一个水鬼帮？
choice:14:2:3.male: Why should I help a Water Wight?
choice:14:2:3.female: Why should I help a Water Wight?

choice:6:0:1.text: Let's hear what you have to say.
choice:6:0:1.male: Let's hear what you have to say.
choice:6:0:1.female: Let's hear what you have to say.

say:23:1220804004:1.text: I had no choice but to join the Wights!
say:23:1220804004:1.source_cn: 我加入水鬼帮是有苦衷的！
say:23:1220804004:1.male: I had no choice but to join the Wights!
say:23:1220804004:1.female: I had no choice but to join the Wights!

choice:6:1:2.text: Why should I help a Water Wight?
choice:6:1:2.source_cn: 我为什么要帮一个水鬼帮？
choice:6:1:2.male: Why should I help a Water Wight?
choice:6:1:2.female: Why should I help a Water Wight?

say:0:1220805001:0.text: Outside the southern city gate, the house at the far west end... This is it!
say:0:1220805001:0.source_cn: 南城门外，最西边的那间房子……就是这里了！那个水鬼帮劳...
say:0:1220805001:0.male: Outside the southern city gate, the house at the far west end... This is it!
say:0:1220805001:0.female: Outside the southern city gate, the house at the far west end... This is it!

say:3:1220806001:0.text: Hi there, we're here to deliver foxtail grass from your husband!
say:3:1220806001:0.source_cn: 你好，我们是来帮你丈夫送狸尾草的！

say:4:1220806002:0.text: By the gods... it truly is foxtail grass! My daughter is saved!
say:4:1220806002:0.source_cn: 女神在上……真的是狸尾草！我的孩子终于有救了！

say:5:1220806003:0.text: But where is my husband? Has something happened to him?
say:5:1220806003:0.source_cn: 不过，我丈夫怎么没回来？该不会出了什么事吧？！

say:6:1220806004:0.source_cn: 这个嘛，的确出了一点事……

say:7:1220806005:1.text: But don't worry! He's quite safe back in Rustport, he'll just have to undergo some hard work for a while.
say:7:1220806005:1.source_cn: 不过你放心！他已经平安回到锈锚港了，只是要卖些力气使劲...

say:8:1220806006:1.text:
That's good then, very good...
But enough—I need to hurry and prepare the medicine for my daughter!
say:8:1220806006:1.source_cn: 那就好，那就好……\n不说这些了。我得赶紧给我女儿制药才行！

say:9:1220806007:1.text: My poor girl's illness has been ongoing for months. She even whimpers in her sleep now...
say:9:1220806007:1.source_cn: 我可怜的女儿，她的病已经拖了好几个月，现在连睡着了都在...

say:10:1220806008:1.text:
But at long last we should finally have all the herbs and ingredients we need...
No, that's not right! We still need <style="highlight">jolly clams</style>!
say:10:1220806008:1.source_cn: 好在总算等到了这一天，药材应该都齐了……\n不，不对，...

choice_prompt:11:1220806008.text:
But at long last we should finally have all the herbs and ingredients we need...
No, that's not right! We still need <style="highlight">jolly clams</style>!
choice_prompt:11:1220806008.source_cn: 好在总算等到了这一天，药材应该都齐了……\n不，不对，还差<style=highlight>笑口贝</style>！

say:12:1220806009:1.text: Yes, I had some prepared already, but it spoils so quickly...
say:12:1220806009:1.source_cn: 是啊，原本我早就备好了，可是贝肉太容易腐坏……
say:12:1220806009:1.male: Yes, I had some prepared already, but it spoils so quickly...
say:12:1220806009:1.female: Yes, I had some prepared already, but it spoils so quickly...

say:13:1220806011:1.text: It's a fairly common ingredient, and you can find some at the <style="highlight">local market</style>. Could you pick some up for me? I'm worried about leaving my daughter alone.
say:13:1220806011:1.source_cn: 不过这东西也是常备的食材，<style=highlig...
say:13:1220806011:1.male: It's a fairly common ingredient, and you can find some at the <style="highlight">local market</style>. Could you pick some up for me? I'm worried about leaving my daughter alone.
say:13:1220806011:1.female: It's a fairly common ingredient, and you can find some at the <style="highlight">local market</style>. Could you pick some up for me? I'm worried about leaving my daughter alone.

say:14:1220806012:1.text: Of course! Leave this small task to us!
say:14:1220806012:1.source_cn: 当然！这种小事，就包在我们身上吧！

say:16:1220806010:1.text: It's simple to find, just difficult to preserve.
say:16:1220806010:1.source_cn: 没有那么麻烦，只是不好存储而已。
say:16:1220806010:1.male: It's simple to find, just difficult to preserve.
say:16:1220806010:1.female: It's simple to find, just difficult to preserve.

choice:11:1:2.text: Would we find this out at sea?
choice:11:1:2.source_cn: 这东西该不会也要出海找吧？
choice:11:1:2.male: Would we find this out at sea?
choice:11:1:2.female: Would we find this out at sea?

say:0:1220807001:0.text: Chippy recalls a fish vendor near the shore.
say:0:1220807001:0.source_cn: 满满记得，靠近沙滩的地方就有个鱼摊。

say:3:1220808001:1.text: Sir, do you have any jolly clams in stock?
say:3:1220808001:1.source_cn: 老板，你这里有笑口贝吗？

say:4:1220808002:1.text: Oh dear, you arrived too late. The jolly clams are all sold out!
say:4:1220808002:1.source_cn: 唉呀，你们来得太晚了，笑口贝早就卖光了！

say:5:1220808003:1.text: Perhaps you'd be interested in something else? My fish are as fresh as any you'll find in the city! The shellfish and shrimp were just harvested, so you can be sure they're fresh and tasty!
say:5:1220808003:1.source_cn: 要不你们看看其它的？我这儿的鱼可不比城里的差！这些贝类...

say:6:1220808004:1.text: Sold out?! What do we do now?!
say:6:1220808004:1.source_cn: 卖光了？！这……这可怎么办啊！

say:7:1220808005:1.text: Why are you so set on jolly clams? As far as I know, it's not an exclusive requirement for any dish, and there are plenty of cheaper and tastier options.
say:7:1220808005:1.source_cn: 为什么非得用笑口贝？我印象里没有哪道菜非得用它才行，比...

say:8:1220808006:1.text: We're not cooking a meal. We need it to make a specific medicine, so we can't replace it with another type of shellfish.
say:8:1220808006:1.source_cn: 我们不是要做菜，而是要用它制作治病的药，所以没办法用其...

say:9:1220808007:1.text: I see. You'll find plenty of jolly clams on the <style="highlight">nearby beach</style>, you can just go and gather some.

say:10:1220808008:1.text:
Really? That's great!
Many thanks, good sir!
say:10:1220808008:1.source_cn: 真的吗？那太好了！\n谢谢你，好心的老板！

say:11:1220808009:1.text: Don't mention it, who hasn't had a time when they've badly needed medicine?
say:11:1220808009:1.source_cn: 不用谢，谁还没有生病急用药的时候呢。

say:12:1220808010:1.text: Just remember, since we're close to Rustport and the water quality isn't the greatest, you should properly clean the jolly clams when preparing your medicine.
say:12:1220808010:1.source_cn: 对了，提醒你们一句，这里离锈锚港很近，水质不太好，你们...

say:1:1220809002:0.text: Chippy is tired of the ocean.

say:0:1220810001:0.text: At last, we've found some jolly clams!

say:1:1220810002:0.text: Let's hurry back and give it to the little girl's mother so we can put an end to her worries.
say:1:1220810002:0.source_cn: 我们赶快回去交给小女孩的妈妈吧，别让她们等急了。

say:3:1220811001:1.text: We're back! And we brought some fresh jolly clams!
say:3:1220811001:1.source_cn: 我们回来啦！带着最新鲜的笑口贝！

say:4:1220811002:1.text: We finally have all the ingredients!

say:5:1220811003:1.text: Sweetheart, just hold on a bit more; Mama will have the medicine ready in no time.
say:5:1220811003:1.source_cn: 我的好孩子，再忍一忍，妈妈马上就把药做好。

say:6:1220811004:1.text: —Wait a moment! I remember the fish stall vendor saying that the water quality nearby isn't great, so the jolly clams need to be properly cleaned.
say:6:1220811004:1.source_cn: ——等一下！我记得鱼摊商人说过，附近的水质不太好，所以...

say:7:1220811005:1.text:
How... how is this done?
I've never prepared medicine on my own before; if I don't do it right, my daughter...
say:7:1220811005:1.source_cn: 这……这要怎么处理？\n我以前从来没有亲手做过药水，万...

say:8:1220811006:1.text: Well, Chippy doesn't have experience making potions and can't give advice... but Hammie might be of assistance!
say:8:1220811006:1.source_cn: 呃，满满不会制作药水，给不出建议……不过漫漫经常制作魔...

say:9:1220811007:1.text: Huh?! But this is a life-saving potion! I... I'm still too prone to making mistakes...
say:9:1220811007:1.source_cn: 哎？！但这可是救命的药水呀！我、我还是太容易失误了……

choice_prompt:10:1220811007.text: Huh?! But this is a life-saving potion! I... I'm still too prone to making mistakes...
choice_prompt:10:1220811007.source_cn: 哎？！但这可是救命的药水呀！我、我还是太容易失误了……

say:11:1220811008:1.text: Truly? Can you really help me?
say:11:1220811008:1.source_cn: 真、真的吗？你能帮我这个忙？
say:11:1220811008:1.male: Truly? Can you really help me?
say:11:1220811008:1.female: Truly? Can you really help me?

say:12:1220811009:1.text: The Magister is the greatest mage alive, so making a simple potion should be a breeze!
say:12:1220811009:1.source_cn: 主人可是最厉害的大魔法师，做瓶药水当然不在话下！
say:12:1220811009:1.male: The Magister is the greatest mage alive, so making a simple potion should be a breeze!
say:12:1220811009:1.female: The Magister is the greatest mage alive, so making a simple potion should be a breeze!

say:13:1220811010:0.text: Amazing... Then I'll leave it to you, Sir Mage! Please... please cure my daughter.
say:13:1220811010:0.source_cn: 太好了，太好了……那就麻烦你了，魔法师<male>先生...
say:13:1220811010:0.male: Amazing... Then I'll leave it to you, Sir Mage! Please... please cure my daughter.
say:13:1220811010:0.female: Amazing... Then I'll leave it to you, Miss Mage! Please... please cure my daughter.

document:14:48:0.source_cn: <style="highlight">三枚笑口贝</style>，<style="highlight">一株狸尾草</style>，清洗干净后研磨成粉末，加水熬制。

document:14:48:0.female: <style="highlight">Three jolly clams,</style> one portion of <style="highlight">foxtail grass</style>. Clean it, grind it into powder, and simmer in water.

say:20:1220811011:0.text: The potion is ready. Madam, have your daughter take it quickly. I believe she'll get better soon!
say:20:1220811011:0.source_cn: 药水做好了。这位夫人，赶快让你女儿服下药水吧。直觉告诉...

say:21:1220811012:1.text: Alright, I'll give it to her right away!
say:21:1220811012:1.source_cn: 好，好……我这就把药喂给她！

narration:22:1220811013:0.text: Upon drinking the potion, the little girl's pain is significantly eased...
narration:22:1220811013:0.source_cn: 服下药水之后，小女孩的疼痛果然得到了缓解……

say:23:1220811014:1.text: Darling, how are you feeling? Does your body still ache?
say:23:1220811014:1.source_cn: 宝贝，你感觉怎么样？身上还疼不疼？

say:26:1220811015:1.text:
I feel... much better than before.
Even standing up... there's no pain!
say:26:1220811015:1.source_cn: 唔……比之前好多了。\n就算站起来……也不疼了！

say:31:1220811017:1.text: That's right, now isn't the time to cry; your daughter needs you to be strong.
say:31:1220811017:1.source_cn: 没错，现在可不是该哭的时候，你还要好好照顾你的女儿呢。

say:32:1220811019:1.text: In any case, I want to thank you all! My daughter's recovery is all thanks to you!
say:32:1220811019:1.source_cn: 无论如何……谢谢你们！我女儿能好起来，都是多亏了各位的帮助！
say:32:1220811019:1.male: In any case, I want to thank you all! My daughter's recovery is all thanks to you!
say:32:1220811019:1.female: In any case, I want to thank you all! My daughter's recovery is all thanks to you!

say:33:1220811020:1.text: Our family will cherish this kindness and never forget it!
say:33:1220811020:1.source_cn: 我们一家会牢记这份恩情，永远都不会忘记！

choice:28:0:1.text: Cheer up, no need to cry.
choice:28:0:1.male: Cheer up, no need to cry.
choice:28:0:1.female: Cheer up, no need to cry.

say:35:1220811018:1.text: Ah, yes. For my daughter's saviors, I've prepared a token of gratitude. It's not much, but please accept it.
